title: LLV-GFL300Q25: full-log tables with quarter-source allocation

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the one LLV-GFL300Q25 configuration in proof.md recovers the full secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch charged work is O(2^(sqrt(n)log2(n)+(17/8)sqrt(n)+2sqrt(n)(log2(n))^(-1/2))), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. Main parameters are v=floor sqrt n,ell=ceil log2n,lambda=ell,P=ell^2,H_n=bit_length(n^P-1),m=floor(P*(v-256ell)/(2H_n+4P+16ell)),kappa=ceil log2(m+2)+3,A_bar=ceil((n+m*kappa)/(m*lambda))+2,center=ceil((m-1)/2),fan_i=A_bar+i-center. The exact prefix and one-qubit finishing instrument handle every remainder. Explicit caps and all-modulus recovery include every failed/discarded request. Section14 deterministically charges per-level attempts to disjoint leaves and proves internal time sqrt(n)log2(n)+(17/8)sqrt(n)+O(sqrt(n)/log n)+O((log n)^2), whose strict gap absorbs all polynomial overhead. Full source/LE, lookup/exclusion, generation, addresses, failures, measurements and cleanup count jointly with every claim.

For this same LLV-GFL300Q25 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak classical space is O(n^3) bits with an absolute outside constant and exact growth index0. With lambda=ceil(log2n),2^lambda=O(n); O(n) retained full-label tables each contain O(n^2) bits. The single current tuple list uses O(n^2); current input/sort/residue arrays use O(n^(5/2)). The complete source/LE, cap arithmetic, stack, streamed decoder and generation ledger uses O(n^2). No full tree, truth table or exponential circuit is stored. This holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success and all other claims.

For this same LLV-GFL300Q25 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak quantum allocation is O(n) qubits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. Pending vector siblings use O(lambda*sum_i fan_i)=O(n); the finish and current fresh search use O(fan_max*lambda)=O(sqrt(n)log n)<=O(n) scratch, reset/reused between trials. Source/LE, rank/projection, failures and abort cleanup are included. The exact centered sum gives m*A_bar*lambda<=n+m*kappa+3m*lambda. This holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success and the other claims.

For this same LLV-GFL300Q25 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, all acquired copies are O(2^((1/4)sqrt n)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. Rejected, failed, discarded and aborted acquisitions count. Dbar=2K*lambda*fan_max*A_bar^m,Dcap=2^12nDbar,Ccap=2^13nDbar. Centered AM-GM bounds the fan-in product by A_bar^m, including prefixes and finishing through fan_max*A_bar^m. Section8 proves A_bar<=2sqrt(n)*(1+5/(2ell)), log2A_bar<=H_n/(2P)+1+15/(4ell)<=D/2-1/(4ell) for D=H_n/P+2+8/ell, and m*log2A_bar<=(v-256ell)/4. Polynomial cap factors therefore fit literal nCcap+K<=2^(v/4). Finite lengths change only outside constants. All claims hold jointly with unconditional full-secret success.

For the same LLV-GFL300Q25 algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
